newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen recovering on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen recovering on retail buying.

text.p: Retail investors in Bangladesh are expected to eye stocks which have lost ground in the past several sessions, which could help reverse recent bearish sentiment, brokers said.

"Scrips which lost in recent sessions despite having strong economic fundamentals might draw buyers. Prices of many a stock have become very attractive," said broker Shakil Rizvi. He said stocks in the cement, pharmaceuticals and food sectors were likely to rise.
The DSE all-share price index closed down 12.88 points or 1.15 percent at 1,105.41 on a turnover of 42.9 milliion taka on Sunday.
